Container.Name: glances-rs
Container.Overview: Lightweight system monitor (CPU, memory, Intel/AMD/NVIDIA GPUs, network, disks, sensors, processes) with a live dashboard on port 61208 and a REST API. No shell or tools inside the image by design.
Container.Description: Host networking plus --pid=host are required: without them the monitor only sees the container, not the server. Intel/AMD GPUs and all CPU stats work out of the box via /sys. For NVIDIA you need Unraid's NVIDIA driver plugin first (stock Unraid ships no NVIDIA driver at all); then keep the nvidia-smi path below and append --runtime=nvidia to Extra Params (the classic Unraid way) or --device nvidia.com/gpu=all on newer Docker. Without NVIDIA hardware, delete that path line. Leave the API key blank for an open dashboard, or set one to gate the data and API behind an X-API-Key header. There is no shell inside the container, so the Unraid console button will not work — this is intentional. Logs are available via the Unraid log button. Memory is capped at 256 MB (the monitor normally uses ~15 MB) so it can never balloon on a small box.

Config.Name: Host sys
Config.Description: Host hardware sensors, DRM GPUs, block stats.

Config.Name: Host root
Config.Description: Host mount table for filesystem stats (pairs with GLANCES_ROOTFS).

Config.Name: nvidia-smi
Config.Description: NVIDIA ONLY: host nvidia-smi binary for GPU util/VRAM/temp. Delete this line without NVIDIA hardware.

Config.Name: GLANCES_ROOTFS
Config.Description: Must match the Host root target above.

Config.Name: GLANCES_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Blank = open dashboard; set = key required.

Config.Name: GLANCES_KWH_RATE
Config.Description: Optional. Dollars per kWh (e.g. 0.30) — enables the monthly power cost. Blank = watts only.
